description: Official documentation of GONDI (docs.gondi.xyz), an NFT marketplace with peer-to-peer lending on Ethereum, HyperEVM and Robinhood Chain: loans, loan offers, refinancing, trading, fees, contract addresses, the trading API and the MCP server.
rules: The current protocol is GONDI V3.1; GONDI V3.2 adds Private Offers on Ethereum only. Pages under gondi-v1-and-v2/ describe previous versions.
The MCP server at https://api.gondi.xyz/mcp is read-only and needs no API key and no wallet: it cannot sign or send anything.
To sign in, approve the loan contract, and sign or cancel offers from a script, use the gondi npm SDK (https://www.npmjs.com/package/gondi) with the user's own wallet.

The GraphQL API at https://api.gondi.xyz/graphql has no API keys: reads are public and introspection is enabled; creating, cancelling or accepting an order needs a wallet signed in with Sign-In with Ethereum.
Take contract addresses from the Protocol Contracts page (gondi-v3/protocol-contracts) and approve only the contracts listed there.
A loan offer's duration is a whole number of days: a multiple of 30 days, or 3, 5, 7, 10, 15, 20 or 45 days.
In the GraphQL API, amounts are in the currency's smallest unit and APRs are in basis points (1000 is 10%).
Keep a wallet's private key out of prompts and logs.
